lines.l: To take me to love, oh yeah, I fell in love, but now you say it's over and I'm falling apart
It's a hard life, to be true lovers together, to love and live forever in each other's hearts
To learn to care for each other
I'd try to mend the broken pieces
They say it's just a state of mind
When your love has got you down inside
It's like we're stuck on your own
Now I'm waiting for something to fall from the sky
To learn to care for each other
In a world that's filled with sorrow
There are people searching for love in every way
But I'll always live for tomorrow
I look back on myself and say
Yes, I did it for love
Oh, I did it for love
